label: Aladdinite
note: American trade name for casein plastic

about.text: Aladdinite was the name of Galalith-type casein-formaldehyde plastic in the US.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.

how.text: Aladdinite is the US trade name for casein-formaldehyde plastic; made like galalith by hardening shaped casein in formaldehyde.
